title: Ravie Dubey Unveiled as Lakshman in New Ramayana Poster Ahead of November 5 Release
excerpt: The makers introduced Dubey as 'A devoted brother. A fearless warrior. Rama's shield.' The actor called playing Lakshman 'an honour and a responsibility' days before Part 1 opens worldwide.
body:
• The makers of Ramayana have unveiled a solo character poster of Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, shown in a warrior stance with bow and arrow.
  • The makers introduced the character with the caption: "A devoted brother. A fearless warrior. Rama's shield."
  • Dubey called the role "an honour and a responsibility that I hold very close to my heart."
  • Ramayana, in Hindi with Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam versions, is a two-part film directed by Nitesh Tiwari: Part 1 releases worldwide on November 5, 2026, and Part 2 is planned for Diwali 2027.

The makers of Ramayana have unveiled a new solo character poster featuring Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, days ahead of the film's scheduled worldwide theatrical release on November 5. The poster shows Dubey in a warrior stance, holding a bow and arrow, and follows a composition similar to the previously unveiled poster of Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, placing the two brothers within a shared visual framework, according to Bollywood Hungama.

Introducing the character on social media, the makers shared the caption, "A devoted brother. A fearless warrior. Rama's shield." Lakshman is known in the epic for his devotion to Rama, and his role as his younger brother and companion through several pivotal events.

"Playing Lakshman is an emotion that is difficult to put into words. He represents a rare combination of strength, courage, devotion and selflessness."

— Ravie Dubey

"His unwavering commitment to Lord Rama and the values he stands for has always been deeply inspiring," Dubey said. "To be entrusted with bringing such a revered character to life is both an honour and a responsibility that I hold very close to my heart. I hope audiences connect with the sincerity and spirit with which we have approached this character."

The film

Ramayana is a Hindi-language two-part cinematic adaptation of the epic, directed by Nitesh Tiwari. It features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. The first instalment is scheduled to release worldwide on November 5, 2026, and the second part is planned for Diwali 2027.

The project is produced by Namit Malhotra's Prime Focus Studios, in association with DNEG and Yash's Monster Mind Creations. It will release in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam, with IMAX among its premium theatrical formats. Sony Pictures will handle global distribution outside India, while Dharma Productions will oversee distribution in the Hindi-speaking market, according to Bollywood Hungama.

Where this fits

The Lakshman poster continues a character-by-character promotional campaign ahead of Part 1, following the Rama poster in the same visual framework. For diaspora audiences, the worldwide day-one release on November 5, in five languages and premium formats including IMAX, means the film opens in US theatres on the same schedule as in India, through Sony Pictures' international distribution.
